description: This file defines the 'Module' class within the Opencart\Catalog\Model\Setting namespace. It interacts with the database to retrieve module settings based on a module ID, returning the settings as a decoded JSON array.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents the module settings model that provides methods to fetch module configuration from the database.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes the settings for a specific module identified by $module_id from the database.
